quarantine.mr_name: CIGAR zero-length op removal preserves alignment semantics
quarantine.oracle: parse(x) == parse(T(x)) after canonical normalization (CIGAR with zero-length ops removed)

evidence.quote: Adjacent CIGAR operations should be different. Zero-length CIGAR operations are allowed but carry no meaning.

ambiguity_flags: The spec says 'should' rather than 'must' for adjacent operations being different, making this a recommendation rather than a strict requirement.

quarantine.mr_name: SEQ case normalization preserves alignment semantics

evidence.quote: No assumptions can be made on the letter cases of the SEQ field. Both upper and lower case letters are permitted.

quarantine.mr_name: RNEXT equals alias toggle preserves alignment semantics

quarantine.mr_name: Unmapped record MAPQ normalization preserves semantics
quarantine.oracle: parse(x) == parse(T(x)) after canonical normalization (MAPQ=255 for unmapped reads)

evidence.quote: MAPQ is set to 255 when the mapping quality is not available, for example when the read is unmapped.

quarantine.mr_name: Mate flag stripping for unpaired reads preserves semantics

evidence.quote: Bit 0x1 (0x1) indicates that the read is paired in sequencing. Bits 0x2, 0x8, 0x20, 0x40, 0x80 are only meaningful when 0x1 is set.

evidence.quote: Bit 0x4: segment unmapped. If this bit is set, RNAME and POS must be '*' and 0 respectively.

quarantine.mr_name: SAM optional tag type character must be one of A,i,f,Z,H,B
quarantine.oracle: All SUTs must REJECT or CRASH on the transformed file; any ACCEPT or SILENT_SKIP is a conformance bug. Consensus oracle votes ACCEPT/REJECT/CRASH/SILENT_SKIP per SUT.

evidence.quote: Each tag is represented in the format TAG:TYPE:VALUE, where TYPE is a single case-sensitive letter which must be one of A, i, f, Z, H, or B.

quarantine.mr_name: SAM paired-end TLEN must have opposite signs for mate reads
quarantine.oracle: All SUTs must REJECT or CRASH on the transformed file; any ACCEPT or SILENT_SKIP is a conformance bug. Consensus oracle votes ACCEPT/REJECT/CRASH/SILENT_SKIP per SUT.

evidence.quote: TLEN is the signed observed Template LENgth. If all segments are mapped to the same reference, the observed length equals the number of bases from the leftmost mapped base to the rightmost mapped base. The two ends of a paired-end read shall have opposite signs.
